about: Reels Studio v4 brief and script set (QA lane). Varied inputs in the shapes Create receives them: a typed brief, a pasted script (the user's own VO), a quote, a rumour, a press-conference story. expect.style is the style a good director should pick (a hint for tests, not a hard rule); expect.modules lists modules that fit the claims; expect.media lists the media kinds the story needs. Facts are illustrative fixtures, not reporting; tests must mock the network and AI.

briefs.brief:
Scottie Scheffler wins the Masters by 4 strokes for his 3rd major title, shooting 11 under par on Sunday. Only the 4th player to win 3 majors before turning 30 since 1980.
Sport: Golf

Max Verstappen takes pole in Brazil after starting the weekend 17th in practice. McLaren had been fastest in every session. He beat Lando Norris by 0.084 seconds.
Sport: Formula 1

Carlos Alcaraz after losing the ATP Finals semi-final: "I played the worst tennis of my season today and I still had match points." He lost 7-6, 3-6, 7-6 and had 2 match points in the third set.
Sport: Tennis

Rumour: Real Madrid are preparing a January bid for Liverpool's Ibrahima Konaté, whose contract runs out in June. Three clubs have asked about him. Liverpool have offered a new deal twice and he has not signed. Sources: The Athletic, Marca (unconfirmed).
Sport: Soccer

Press conference: Jets head coach asked three times whether he will call plays after a 2-8 start. He said 'we'll evaluate everything' each time. The Jets have scored under 20 points in 7 of 10 games. Owner meets with the GM on Tuesday.
Sport: NFL

Victor Wembanyama has 5+ blocks in 9 straight games, the longest streak since 1985-86. The Spurs are 7-2 in those games. No other player has more than 4 such games this season.
Sport: NBA

Caitlin Clark set the WNBA single-season assist record with 337 assists, passing the old mark of 316. She did it in 40 games. The Fever went from 13 wins to 20.
Sport: WNBA

Dallas was up 21. They lost on a 59-yard field goal with two seconds left. Everyone blames the fourth down. It wasn't the fourth down. Chapter one: the run. Dallas stopped running with the lead. Their pass rate went from 47 to 57 percent. Chapter two: the throw. Fourth and one, they dropped back, sacked for minus nine. Chapter three: the choice. Backing off is a choice. Cowboys fans, your call.
LeBron James just played his 23rd season. Nobody in NBA history has played more. He is still averaging over 20 points. Twenty-three seasons. Think about that.

Three reasons the Liberty win it all again. Number three: the bench, best net rating in the league. Number two: Sabrina Ionescu in the fourth quarter. Number one: Breanna Stewart. Check, check, check. Liberty fans, your call.
Rory McIlroy was asked about the Ryder Cup captaincy. He said, 'not yet.' Two words. Here's why that matters.
